name: One-shot /rotate-backlog: consolidate the doc debt, then archive
objective: Rework /rotate-backlog so one invocation does the whole clean-up: check docs-debt first and archive nothing up front; when any phase owes consolidation, create the docs phase through create-phase's docs-phase route (the invocation is the operator's yes for the engine-drafted name, objective and docs-debt scope; the proposal is still printed) and run it end to end through do-whole-phase in auto on the default stream (gate as the opt-in word), then archive every done phase, the docs phase included; when nothing owes, archive the done phases right away. The docs phase jumps the queue ahead of planned work when every other slice on the stream is at a boundary, and /rotate-backlog stops and reports when a slice is mid-flight (in_progress or pending). A stop (pending, blocked, needs_operator, a failed review) ends the run and the next /rotate-backlog resumes from the live docs phase; archive-only keeps the archive-and-report path. Ships as workspace v54 (P32 ships v53).

review.note: pass: smoke 247/0, build --check and validate pass; every rotate= branch run live in a scratch copy by the review and again by the orchestrator at the gate; doc_versions none (parallel mode: qa gate section and Operator Runtime check recorded as tagged Doc impact notes); gate cleared on the operator's say-so; D3 wording nits deferred
